learning_objective: 🎯 We will explore different shapes, count their corners and edges, and create fun patterns!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Shapes like squares and triangles have straight lines called edges and pointy parts called corners. A circle is round and has no straight edges!
We can put small flat shapes together to make bigger pictures, just like a Tangram puzzle. Two triangles can make a square!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Shape Hunt Safari
fun_activity.instructions: Walk around your house and find 3 things that are rectangles and 2 things that are circles. Draw them in your notebook!

quick_recap: ⭐ Different shapes have different numbers of edges and corners.
⭐ We can join basic shapes together to build amazing designs.
